name: Acquired Immunity
body:
Benefit(s): Choose a number of poisons or diseases with unique names equal to your Constitution modifier. You become immune to those specific poisons or diseases. You may select magical diseases with this feat.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times, each time selecting an additional number of poisons or diseases.
